meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ычно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: Right, then as usual.

examples.text: А в каких местах он обычно пьёт?
examples.trans: And in what places does he usually drink?

examples.text: Он обычно встаёт в семь утра.
examples.trans: He usually gets up at seven in the morning.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('milk-fed, dairy').

examples.text: Я уберу из меню молочного ягнёнка.
examples.trans: I will remove the milk-fed lamb from the menu.
Milk-fed lamb on the grill.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нятно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must').

examples.trans: This is a restaurant! It must be edible.

examples.text: Вы не должны стоять и бездельничать.

examples.text: Об этом никто не должен знать, ясно?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тоять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to stand', paired with 'постоять'.

examples.text: Вы не должны стоять и бездельничать.
examples.trans: You must not stand around and loaf.

meanings.note: Privative prefix 'без-' ('without, -less') (stem 'дельничать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to loaf around, be idle'.

meanings.en: to be found, to turn up
meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'йтись'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'is found', paired with 'находиться'.

examples.text: Витя, я тебя просил найти человека!
examples.trans: Vitya, I asked you to find a person!
Say thank you that the dog was found.
The keys turned up!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'forward', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Go ahead.

examples.text: Вы взяточник! Вы лезете вперёд больного ребёнка.
examples.trans: You're a bribe-taker! You're pushing in ahead of a sick child.

examples.text: Иди вперёд и покори её сердце!
examples.trans: Go ahead and win her heart!
